messages:
Anita Patel: Heads up — new model candidate 'maya-70b-QLoRA' popped up from a partner bench. Quick triage/prioritization please. High-level: p50 latency ~180ms on A100x2, instr-follow +2.3 vs baseline, perplexity ~12.5 on internal eval set. Is this worth full onboarding?

Matt Chung: Can you paste the cost delta vs atlas-40b? ballpark tokens/sec or memory numbers?

Devon Reyes: I kicked a quick quant test last night. FP16 -> 8-bit gives ~1.6x throughput improvement but saw regressions on multi-turn instruction traces. Small log excerpt:```FAIL: hallucinated citation in summarization test (turn 3)``` Need a structured sweep.

Sara López: My gut: prioritize if quality >= +2 and cost <= 1.3x. Also Q3 roadmap wants long-form summarization improvements, so model could be strategic. Need full eval matrix though (safety, quals, summarization, conv retention).

EvalBot: Auto-eval summary: convo-bench +6% win, summarize-bench +4%, safety-bench shows a small uptick in risky completions (+0.9 pts). Detailed results uploaded to /evals/maya-70b/1855554321/report.html

Anita Patel: Proposed immediate next steps: 1) Full eval suite run (Sara) — regressions + feature-specific tests. 2) Quantization sweep (Devon) — int8/configs for instruction fidelity. 3) Infra smoke (Matt) — p50/p95/p99, OOM, KV cache effects. 4) Canary A/B design for internal product teams (Anita/Sara). Who owns 1/2/3/4 and ETAs? :calendar:

Matt Chung: I can own infra smoke. Will run GPU perf + p99/oom matrix on A100 and V100 variants. ETA: EOD Thu. Adding checklist item: KV cache sizing + high-ctx stress.

Devon Reyes: I'll own the quant sweep. Need model weights and the latest prompt set. Plan: test configs {FP16, int8-q, int8-sym, int4-approx}, compare instr-follow + perplexity. ETA: Mon COB. Will log failures to /tmp/maya-quant-1855.log and paste failing prompts.

Sara López: I'll run the eval suite and assemble acceptance criteria. Suggest acceptance: (a) summary score >= current +1 point, (b) no safety-bench regressions >5 pts, (c) cost <= 1.2x unless quality >+3. Also require no multi-turn degradation >2 pts. I'll post the metric dashboard link when ready.

Anita Patel: Acceptance criteria noted. Also add operational items: model size on disk, cold-start latency, model version tagging, rollback plan, and telemetry hooks (traceID + token-level cost). If quant sweep fails hostile cases, fallback plan = serve atlas-40b with caching + prompt tweaks.

Matt Chung: Adding infra smoke command for reproducibility:
```bash
# run perf script
python infra/perf.py --model maya-70b --batch 1 --ctx 4096 --measure p50,p95,p99 --repeat 20
```
Will post results to the thread.

Devon Reyes: Noted. I'll include reproducer snippet for the hallucination case and tag it:```
PROMPT: "Summarize with sources: ..."
REPRO: seed=42; temp=0.2; max_tokens=512
```

EvalBot: Friendly reminder: attach deterministic seed and the eval corpus version (corpus_v=2026-02-28) for reproducibility.

Sara López: Also propose we add a small user-facing A/B that tests long-form summarization on internal docs: 100 users, 1 week, measure clarity + factuality. If infra + quant look good, roll canary after Monday review.

Anita Patel: Scheduling: let's slot a 30-min triage on Mon 09:30 in model-prio. If you can't make it, post updates here before the meeting. Thanks — this looks promising but we need the sweep + safety checks before greenlight. :eyes:

Matt Chung: Ack. I'll drop interim perf numbers by Thu.

Devon Reyes: Ack, adding configs and logging.

Sara López: Will prepare the eval dashboard and acceptance test checklist.

EvalBot: Run queued: evals/maya-70b/queued (id=ev-185555). Estimated completion 12h.

Anita Patel: Great — keeping thread for updates. If anyone discovers major safety regressions, please ping @security and @ops immediately.

Devon Reyes: Quick note: found one deterministic fail repro that crops up only under context > 2048 tokens; adding stress test to the quant sweep.

Sara López: Added that to the checklist. Thanks everyone.

Anita Patel: Closing loop: owners = Sara (evals), Devon (quant), Matt (infra), Anita (canary/coord). Review Mon 09:30.
